breadcrumbs.current: Geographical Distribution and Characteristics of Prehistory

hero.title: प्रागैतिहासिक काल: भूगोल और विशेषताएं
hero.description: भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में पुरापाषाण, मध्यपाषाण और नवपाषाण बस्तियों और उनके पारिस्थितिक निर्धारकों का विस्तृत विश्लेषण।

timeline.title: कालानुक्रमिक ढांचा
timeline.description: पत्थर की तकनीक के आधार पर भारत में मानव जीवन के विकासात्मक चरण।

cards.details: हस्त-कुल्हाड़ी और क्लीवर उद्योगों का विकास (सोहन और मद्रासियन संस्कृति)।
संक्रमण काल; माइक्रोलिथ (लघुपाषाण) उपकरणों और शिकार से खेती की ओर बदलाव।
स्थायी जीवन, कृषि, मृदभांड और पॉलिश किए गए पत्थर के औजार।

mnemonics.title: याद रखने के तरीके (Mnemonics)
mnemonics.description: प्रमुख क्षेत्रीय स्थलों के लिए स्मृति सहायक।

items.title: B.A.D. - स्थल समूह
items.decryption: यह पुरापाषाण कालीन मुख्य क्षेत्रों को दर्शाता है: एमपी (भीमबेटका), तमिलनाडु (अत्तिरामपक्कम), और राजस्थान (डीडवाना)।

traps.title: यूपीएससी के सामान्य जाल
items: माइक्रोलिथ को केवल नवपाषाण काल से जोड़ना (ये मध्यपाषाण की विशेषता हैं)।
सिंधु घाटी को भारतीय इतिहास का शुरुआती बिंदु मानना (प्रागैतिहास इससे हजारों साल पहले का है)।
यह सोचना कि तांबे के औजारों (ताम्रपाषाण) ने पत्थर को तुरंत बदल दिया; वे सदियों तक साथ रहे।

deepDive.title: Syllabus Core Study Notes (Deep-Dive)
deepDive.description: Master the spatial mapping, site categorizations, raw material networks, and cultural-environmental characteristics of Indian prehistory.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
भूगोल

  • सदाबहार नदियों के पास स्थल
  • गुफा आश्रय (विंध्य)
  • जलोढ़ मैदान बनाम पठार

विशेषताएं

  • औजार तकनीक का विकास
  • भोजन संग्रह से उत्पादन
  • शैल चित्रकला
कालउपकरण प्रकारमुख्य स्थल
पुरापाषाणकोर टूल्सभीमबेटका
मध्यपाषाणमाइक्रोलिथबागोर
नवपाषाणपॉलिश पत्थरमेहरगढ़
  • पुरापाषाण: भोजन संग्रह; सोहन घाटी (पंजाब) और मद्रासियन संस्कृति।
  • मध्यपाषाण: मछली पकड़ना और शिकार; बागोर (राजस्थान) और आदमगढ़ (एमपी)।
  • नवपाषाण: पशुपालन; मेहरगढ़ (बलूचिस्तान) में गेहूं/जौ के प्रमाण।

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Attirampakkam (Practice Q0)?
opts: earliest Acheulian tool assembly dating to >1.5 MYA
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Attirampakkam is defined primarily by its Lower Paleolithic Acheulian characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Bhimbetka (Practice Q1)?
opts: continuous habitation and prehistoric rock shelters
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Bhimbetka is defined primarily by its Paleolithic to Mesolithic rock art characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Mehrgarh (Practice Q2)?
opts: earliest farming, wheat-barley cultivation and cattle herding
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Mehrgarh is defined primarily by its Neolithic to Chalcolithic transition characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Burzahom (Practice Q3)?
opts: subterranean pit dwellings and dog burials in graves
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Burzahom is defined primarily by its Northern Neolithic characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Chirand (Practice Q4)?
opts: extraordinary abundance of bone tools made of antler tips
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Chirand is defined primarily by its Middle Gangetic Neolithic characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Bagor (Practice Q5)?
opts: largest Mesolithic settlement on the Kothari river with early pastoral evidence
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Bagor is defined primarily by its Mesolithic characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Langhnaj (Practice Q6)?
opts: microlithic hunting tools, wild animal bones and human burials
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Langhnaj is defined primarily by its Mesolithic sand dune site characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Hunsgi (Practice Q7)?
opts: intensive tool manufacturing using locally available limestone
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Hunsgi is defined primarily by its Lower Paleolithic characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Didwana (Practice Q8)?
opts: habitation horizons near hyper-saline playa lakes in the Thar desert
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Didwana is defined primarily by its Paleolithic sequence characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Atranjikhera (Practice Q9)?
opts: earliest iron smelting furnaces and slag evidence in Gangetic Doab
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Atranjikhera is defined primarily by its PGW and Early Iron Age characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Inamgaon (Practice Q10)?
opts: large fortified settlement, granaries, and specialized burial practices
Urban town planning with grid street system
practiceQuestions.sol: The site of Inamgaon is defined primarily by its Jorwe Chalcolithic characteristics.

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following represents the core geo-archaeological feature of the prehistoric site of Daojali Hading (Practice Q11)?

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the prehistoric geography (Mock Q0):
1. Attirampakkam is located in Tamil Nadu.
2. It yields evidence of earliest Acheulian tool assembly dating to >1.5 MYA.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct based on the geographical distribution mapping of Attirampakkam.
